question: Double the mass and show how the landing changes.

objects.content: More mass means less upward acceleration

annotations.text: Impact speed was downward, so the rocket hit the ground after falling.

beats.say: Doubling the mass changed the rocket’s acceleration under the same 14,400 N thrust from +0.12 to -4.84 m/s². The heavier rocket could no longer climb; it started accelerating downward.

object.content: More mass means less upward acceleration

beats.say: In the doubled-mass run, the rocket crashed after 4.99 s. At impact, its vertical speed was -36.07 m/s, and 425.21 kg of fuel remained.

annotations.text: Row sum stays 1; the mix of source values changes
